what: Walker targets $RUN_DIR/breadcrumbs under the log staging tree
scenario_or_breakage: Live streams and sidecars live in $IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs (sibling of larch-logs), not under larch_log_run_dir; commit copies only src_path so breadcrumbs never reach larch-logs/<run-id>/breadcrumbs/ (failure mode #3)
suggested_fix: Resolve session tmpdir from --log-root (e.g. dirname of log root for implement) or require IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/DESIGN_TMPDIR/REVIEW_TMPDIR; walk <session_tmp>/breadcrumbs/*.ndjson; write redacted outputs into src_path/breadcrumbs/ before cp/git
